info.name: Restaurant Reservation - Final Project
info.description: Run the entire collection in order against a NEW final-project database after npm run seed and npm run create-admin. Set baseUrl/adminEmail/adminPassword locally. Creates two uniquely named test accounts per run; cleans their reservations and reviews. Does not delete accounts; test menu items are deactivated (not deleted). About 80 requests: the API allows 100 per 10 minutes, so wait before re-running. Cookies disabled except explicitly supplied test headers. Each request asserts response time <3000ms. Tokens use run-local variables and are not exported.
